note: Second evaluation generation. Separate results archive (research/registry-v2/), never mixed with v1. Every v1 criterion is RESTATED HERE AT ITS EXACT v1 VALUE and no v1 threshold is changed — v2 is additive, so a v2 run and a v1 run are comparable on the shared 18 and differ only on the seven robustness criteria v2 adds. A different protocol_hash marks them as a different experiment (see registry.currentState).
adds: anchored walk-forward with per-fold re-optimisation on train only
bootstrap / block-bootstrap Monte Carlo over trade OUTCOMES, not order
deflated Sharpe ratio against the number of hypotheses actually tried
drawdown distribution under random fill and size error
fine-grained slippage and fee sweep with an explicit break-even cost

walk_forward.why_coverage: without it a strategy that goes silent out of sample scores 100% consistency across the folds that did fire; verified against a signal silent for the final 37% of the sample, which cleared every walk-forward criterion with perfect marks

bootstrap.why_block: trades arrive in clusters of consecutive bars within one trend, so iid resampling understates the tail

deflated_sharpe.why_not_zero: DSR > 0 only asks that the observed Sharpe exceed E[max of N trials], which at N=74 is 2.31 per trade — unreachable, so the criterion is a constant 0 for every strategy and discriminates nothing. DSR >= 0.95 is the same 95% one-sided confidence used in robustness.deflatedSharpe.survivesMultipleTesting, so the gate and the statistic agree.
deflated_sharpe.trial_count_source: sum of grid variants evaluated across every strategy in the archive; the card count is reported alongside as the lower bound

slippage_sweep.why_finer_than_v1: v1 steps 1x/2x/5x and can step straight over the cliff, reporting 'survives nothing' when the true break-even sits between two multipliers
slippage_sweep.why_paired: survival depends on the SUM of fee and slippage, so the diagonal plus the two axis legs bound the break-even in a third of the simulations the full cross product needs. Cost survival is already a v1 criterion; this refines WHERE the cliff is, it does not re-decide whether it exists
